recommendation: Keep the empty audit commit. Do not add redundant boundary prose for FHIR-5941; any further wording cleanup should follow the later unresolved typo tracker or a new Pharmacy decision.
issue_request: FHIR-5941 was a Published/Persuasive Pharmacy clarification from DSTU1 asking to clarify when a medication record is a MedicationAdministration versus a MedicationStatement, including scenarios where administration happened but the record was entered or reported by someone else.
initial_application: No repository commit explicitly mentions FHIR-5941. The Jira resolution says the change was made as part of FHIR-7167 and FHIR-5916, and commit 7d50996061 added the MedicationStatement purpose and primary-difference wording, followed by e7200c208f for a build-text adjustment.
additional_context: MedicationAdministration and MedicationStatement are active approved Pharmacy resources in source/fhir.ini. Later TR#12356 boundary work, FHIR-37948 editorial wording, and the already-published FHIR-38873 naming cleanup preserved the same distinction. FHIR-53876 is a later Triaged typo issue and was not treated as a final source-change decision.
reconciliation: No source change was made. Current conformance and narrative source already says MedicationAdministration has complete actual administration information, while MedicationStatement is reported or derived, broader than a specific event, and often less specific.

related_jiras.note: Published/Persuasive with Modification issue whose resolution supplied the detailed MedicationStatement purpose and explicit MedicationStatement-vs-MedicationAdministration difference.
Published/Persuasive with Modification issue addressed by the same MedicationStatement usage clarification family.
